question: What farm-gate price and margin would make food-grade soybean (and mung bean) competitive with maize, vegetables or a third rice crop in two or three Vietnamese farm types (Red River Delta winter crop after rice; upland Lam Dong (former Dak Nong); Mekong rice-upland rotation)?
why_it_matters: Decides candidate PPE-C1. The EU fava roadmap shows the farm business case is the first constraint; we found no Vietnamese farm-economics study of soybean or mung bean in rotations (PPE-13)
cheapest_way_to_close: Farm-archetype model on the EU roadmap pattern, fed by provincial extension cost norms and 10 to 20 farmer interviews in two provinces; or a request to VSAC for its contract-farm cost data
owner_org_to_ask: Vinasoy VSAC; MAE crop and extension agencies; Can Tho University

question: How many tonnes of domestic soybeans did Vinasoy and the largest tofu makers buy in 2025, at what price premium over imported beans, and under what contract terms?
why_it_matters: OQ-463 asks the domestic share of soy-food beans; the 2025 QNS annual report describes VSAC and a 2026 plan to invest in soybean raw-material areas but gives no tonnage (AIB-06)
cheapest_way_to_close: One call each to Vinasoy (QNS investor relations) and ToFu House; QNS annual report 2026

question: What is the landed price of imported identity-preserved non-GM food soybeans (Canada, United States) in Vietnam, by month, compared with commodity beans?
why_it_matters: Sets the price ceiling for domestic food soybean (PPE-C1). 2023 annual unit values differ little by origin (Canada USD 686/t, Brazil USD 627/t; our calculation from SEC-05), so the non-GM premium may be small
cheapest_way_to_close: Declaration-level customs data for HS 1201 by importer, or quotes from two food-bean importers

question: Does the annex of MARD Decision 811/QD-BNN-TT (2024 action plan for the crop strategy) assign any task on soybean, mung bean or other food legumes, and has MAE named any legume in its 2026 'domestic raw-material areas' task?
why_it_matters: The crop strategy sets no soybean target (NTS-22); a task in the action plan would be the policy hook for a legume taskforce
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the annex of Decision 811 (only the 4-page body was read); targeted search of mae.gov.vn
owner_org_to_ask: MAE Department of Crop Production and Plant Protection
